newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Sentiment aided by firm corn.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Sentiment aided by firm corn.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were steady to stronger Monday boosted by the continued firm tone of CBOT corn prices, millfeed dealers said.
"If this corn board (CBOT futures) keeps roaring up we're going to see the same thing in wheat mids," one dealer said.
Dealers said the sharp advance in CBOT futures had prompted sellers to back away from the market and many prices were nominal.
"I don't have any offers. We're going to have to wait until it (CBOT corn) settles," another dealer said.
CBOT March corn closed six cents a bushel higher at $3.12 after earlier setting a 5-1/2 month high for the nearby contract of $3.14.
